candidate.name: E2_preflight
candidate.policy: uncertainty proxy with queue thresholds selecting 32/64 frames or retrieval-only

evidence.observation: The uncalibrated E2 replay selects more high-frame modes in burst scenarios and produces more timeouts than fixed16; the replay does not execute a service and has no quality measurement.
evidence.quality_observation: The 64-frame candidate has a small aggregate Top-k gain but opposite source-group effects and about 41% higher mean rerank time on the additional held-out set.
evidence.real_observation: E3 queue-bypass reduces service P95 by about 21% in both burst and 1-second steady runs, but selects retrieval-only for 49/50 rows, loses 14 percentage points of pilot Top-k@0.5, and still has 50/50 deadline misses.
evidence.runtime_micro_optimization_observation: Retaining the CUDA allocator cache preserves pilot Top-k@0.5=0.68 but has paired service P95 3522.7 ms versus 3519.0 ms with empty_cache, so it is discarded as a G5 latency candidate.
evidence.single_reader_observation: Eliminating the duplicate metadata VideoReader preserves quality and reduces mean/P50 service time, but increases 50-row burst P95 by about 1.1%; retain as an implementation cleanup, not as a G5 pass.
evidence.prefetch_observation: Overlapping the next full-video CPU frame read with the current GPU request preserves fixed16 Top-k@0.5=0.68 and reduces service P95 by 42.8% in burst and 45.7% at 1-second arrivals. However, the queue remains overloaded: 48/50 burst and 44/50 steady requests still miss the 5-second deadline, so this is not a G5 promotion.
evidence.multi_gpu_observation: Two local GPU workers with one-request lookahead prefetch preserve Top-k@0.5=0.68 and clear the 5-second deadline in the 50-row steady-1s run (0/50 timeouts), but the burst run still has 46/50 timeouts and P95 total latency about 39.9 s. This is capacity evidence, not a burst-safe G5 promotion or a service implementation.
evidence.batch_smoke_observation: Mixed-length two-request forward fails with FlashAttention index assertions; exact same-length 2x16-frame forward succeeds but takes 18.22 s versus 4.61 s for two sequential requests (peak 18.84 GiB). Restricted rank_batch is retained as a correctness experiment, not a latency candidate.
evidence.admission_observation: On the two-GPU prefetch burst run, accepting only requests completed within 5 seconds would retain quality for 4/50 rows but reject or mark 46/50 as late; explicit admission is therefore not a useful quality-preserving G5 promotion.

next_action: Keep E0 fixed16; do not start Phase 6 service or pressure testing. A future policy must reduce tail latency without the observed retrieval-only or low-frame quality loss and must be rechecked on an independent quality pool.
